digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler subtree comment inventory and relocation
propositions: Comment marker counts in reconciler subtree were incorrectly estimated at 28 sites; actual measurement yields 6 RELOCATED VERBATIM occurrences, 6 module-size-cap mentions, and 10 affected files

Stale comments in _backend_registry.py incorrectly mark select_backend as unimplemented stub despite live imports from 13 modules; S3/S4-not-landed notes in _backend.py and adapters/jira/backend.py are outdated

Four categories of comments restated 4–8 times across the subtree (field-convergence fit-then-normalize, pagination-stall aborts, unmapped relations, core value maps) require new or amended ADRs as single-source destinations before relocations collapse those arguments
The do_not_move list and ADRs must be committed in write-order: destinations (ADRs) first, then comments citing them, to avoid dangling references and loss of domain arguments
Recoverable line count must be measured from actual relocation work (not pre-estimated), and load-bearing external-API facts must remain verbatim to preserve unmergeable domain constraints
